battle_traits.name: Grimmdron Grudges
battle_traits.effect: Each time a friendly FYRD OF FYREPEAK unit destroys an enemy unit, give that friendly unit 1 grudge mark.

battle_traits.name: Rune of Fortune
battle_traits.effect: You can only use this ability if you have not used any UR-GOLD RUNE abilities this battle round. For the rest of the battle round, if the unmodified hit roll for a shooting attack that targets a friendly FYRD OF FYREPEAK unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

battle_traits.name: Rune of Spellbreaking
battle_traits.effect:
You can only use this ability if you have not used any UR-GOLD RUNE abilities this battle round. For the rest of the battle round:
• Subtract 2 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for enemy units.
• Add 1 to chanting rolls for friendly FYRD OF FYREPEAK units.

battle_traits.name: Rune of Guarding
battle_traits.effect: You can only use this ability if you have not used any UR-GOLD RUNE abilities this battle round. For the rest of the battle round, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each friendly FYRD OF FYREPEAK unit in each phase.

battle_traits.name: Rune of Speed
battle_traits.effect: You can only use this ability if you have not used any UR-GOLD RUNE abilities this battle round. For the rest of the battle round, you can re-roll run rolls and charge rolls for friendly FYRD OF FYREPEAK units.

battle_traits.name: Rune of Striking
battle_traits.effect: You can only use this ability if you have not used any UR-GOLD RUNE abilities this battle round. For the rest of the battle round, add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made by friendly FYRD OF FYREPEAK units.

entries.name: Foe-seeker
entries.declare: Pick an enemy HERO to be the nemesis for the rest of the battle. You can pick an enemy unit in reserve.
entries.effect:
• If the enemy nemesis is destroyed by the HERO with this trait, give 1 grudge mark to each friendly FYRD OF FYREPEAK unit on the battlefield after removing the destroyed unit.
• If this HERO is within 12" of the enemy nemesis when it is destroyed without having destroyed it themselves, give 1 grudge mark to each visible friendly FYRD OF FYREPEAK unit wholly within 12" of them after removing the destroyed unit.

entries.name: Lodge Relic
entries.effect: While this HERO is damaged and the number of damage points allocated to it is equal to or greater than half its Health characteristic (rounding down), the melee weapons of other friendly FYRD OF FYREPEAK units have Crit (Mortal) while they are wholly within 6" of and visible to it.

entries.name: Grimnir's Protection
entries.declare: Pick a friendly FYRD OF FYREPEAK PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly FYRD OF FYREPEAK unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: If the chanting roll was 6+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Each target has WARD (5+) until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Grimnir's Geyser
entries.declare: Pick a friendly FYRD OF FYREPEAK PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly FYRD OF FYREPEAK unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: If the chanting roll was 9+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Remove each target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Grimnir's Fury
entries.declare: Pick a friendly FYRD OF FYREPEAK PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 4+ instead.

battle_traits.name: Venerated Sentinels
battle_traits.declare: Pick a visible friendly GHOLEM unit within 3" of your High Kyng Valankrom to be the venerated sentinels.
battle_traits.effect:
For the rest of the battle:
• While the friendly venerated sentinels are within the combat range of your High Kyng Valankrom, both units have WARD (5+).
• Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by the friendly venerated sentinels that target an enemy unit in combat with your High Kyng Valankrom.

battle_traits.name: High Kyng's Grudgebearer
battle_traits.declare: Pick up to D3 visible enemy units visible to your High Kyng Valankrom to be the targets.
battle_traits.effect: Each target is a wrongdoer for the rest of the battle.

battle_traits.name: Make Them Pay for Their Affronts
battle_traits.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of your High Kyng Valankrom to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: The target is a wrongdoer for the rest of the battle.

battle_traits.name: The Gall of It!
battle_traits.declare: Pick each enemy unit that used an ability that inflicted any damage points on your High Kyng Valankrom this turn to be the targets.
battle_traits.effect: Each target is a wrongdoer for the rest of the battle.

battle_traits.name: Never Forget Their Perfidy
battle_traits.effect: Friendly THRONG OF VALANKROM units count as having 1 grudge mark while they are in combat with an enemy wrongdoer unit.

battle_traits.name: Dreng Tromm!
battle_traits.effect: If your High Kyng Valankrom has been destroyed, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly THRONG OF VALANKROM units for the rest of the battle.

battle_traits.name: The Hour of Judgement
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly THRONG OF VALANKROM unit to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the phase, the target counts as having 1 grudge mark, but it can only pick enemy wrongdoer units as the targets of its shooting attacks.

entries.name: Fearless and Honour-bound
entries.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for friendly THRONG OF VALANKROM units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

entries.name: Grombrindalian Pipe
entries.effect: This unit has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Rune of Vigour
entries.declare: Pick a friendly THRONG OF VALANKROM WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly THRONG OF VALANKROM units while they are visible and wholly within 12" of the caster.

entries.name: Rune of Banishment
entries.declare: Pick a friendly THRONG OF VALANKROM WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• Subtract 1 from casting rolls, chanting rolls and unbinding rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of this unit.
• Add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, when making banishment rolls for friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

entries.name: Rune of Upheaval
entries.declare: Pick a friendly THRONG OF VALANKROM WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a visible enemy unit within 12" of the caster uses a command, roll a dice in reaction. On a 6+, the command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use it are lost.

battle_traits.name: Stone and Sky
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO KHAZALITE HOLDS INFANTRY unit and a friendly non-HERO KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY unit that are within ½" of each other to be the targets.
battle_traits.effect:
For the rest of the battle round, while the targets are within ½" of each other:
• The targets have the STONE AND SKY keyword.
• Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target those friendly units.

battle_traits.name: Duardin Pride
battle_traits.effect: Add 10 to the control scores of friendly THRONGANKOR ALLIANCE units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to any friendly STONE AND SKY units.

battle_traits.name: Hammer and Anvil
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly non-STONE AND SKY THRONGANKOR ALLIANCE unit that is in combat to be the anvil. Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the anvil to be the workpiece. Finally, pick a friendly THRONGANKOR ALLIANCE unit that is not in combat and does not have the same faction keyword (i.e. KHAZALITE HOLDS or KHARADRON OVERLORDS) as the anvil to be the hammer.
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the turn, the hammer's ranged weapons have Crit (2 Hits) for shooting attacks that target the workpiece.

battle_traits.name: Transport Duardin
battle_traits.timing: Reaction: You declared a MOVE ability for a friendly SKYVESSEL in your movement phase
battle_traits.effect:
Pick a number of THRONGANKOR ALLIANCE INFANTRY units up to that SKYVESSEL's Transport Capacity (see its warscroll) that are wholly within 6" of it, visible to it and not in combat to be the targets. Units that have been transported this turn cannot be targets.
Remove the targets from the battlefield. After the SKYVESSEL ends its move, you must set up each target unit on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of that SKYVESSEL and not in combat. Those units have been transported. A unit cannot use CHARGE abilities if it was transported in the same turn.

battle_traits.name: The Vice
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly non-STONE AND SKY KHAZALITE HOLDS unit and a friendly non-STONE AND SKY KHARADRON OVERLORDS unit that are in combat with the same enemy unit to be the friendly targets. Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with both friendly targets to be the enemy target.
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the turn, the friendly targets' melee weapons have Crit (Mortal) for combat attacks that target the enemy target.

battle_traits.name: Allied Grudgement
battle_traits.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 12" of and visible to a STONE AND SKY unit in your army
battle_traits.effect: Pick a friendly THRONGANKOR ALLIANCE unit and give it 1 grudge mark.

entries.name: Stronger When Alloyed
entries.effect: If this unit is a KHAZALITE HOLDS unit, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons while it is within 3" of any visible friendly KHARADRON OVERLORDS units. If this unit is a KHARADRON OVERLORDS unit, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons while it is within 3" of any visible friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS units.

entries.name: Throngankor Flare
entries.declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE THRONGANKOR ALLIANCE INFANTRY unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
entries.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 3" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Rune of Spirit
entries.declare: Pick a friendly THRONGANKOR ALLIANCE WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while there is another visible friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS unit and a visible friendly KHARADRON OVERLORDS unit wholly within 12" of the caster, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly THRONGANKOR ALLIANCE units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster.

entries.name: Rune of Defence
entries.declare: Pick a friendly THRONGANKOR ALLIANCE WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while there is another visible friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS unit and a visible friendly KHARADRON OVERLORDS unit wholly within 12" of the caster, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly THRONGANKOR ALLIANCE units wholly within 12" of the caster.

entries.name: Redeclaration of Alliance
entries.declare: Pick a friendly THRONGANKOR ALLIANCE PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by visible enemy units while they are within 9" of this unit, in combat with any friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS units and in combat with any friendly KHARADRON OVERLORDS units. If the chanting roll was 10+, add 3" to the range of this ability.
